what_matters.tag_note: US midterms · overnight, and Asia this morning
what_matters.head: The AP projects that Democrats win both the House and the Senate, and US stock futures and Asian chip stocks fell on it.
what_matters.detail: CNBC said traders worry a Democratic Congress could bring curbs on data centres; in Texas the AP projects Gina Hinojosa beats Greg Abbott for governor, and she has pledged a moratorium on data centres there. In CNBC's latest update S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were each down 0.6%, off their lows. By 12:05 SGT SK Hynix was down 6.7% and Samsung 4.8%; Investing.com put Japan's Nikkei down 4.5% and Singapore's STI down 1.4% this morning. None of this is in Tuesday's US prices.

what_matters.head: UOB fell 6.5%, about 5.3 times its usual daily move, after Q3 profit came in below analysts' figures.
what_matters.detail: Q3 net profit was S$1.25B against the S$1.37B Bloomberg's survey of analysts expected. Net interest margin slipped to 1.68% from 1.74% in Q2, below the 1.75–1.80% range UOB gave for full-year 2026 (Reuters, Nov 2025); the report found does not say whether UOB changed that forecast. Fees rose 19% from a year earlier to a record S$733M, and trading and investment income fell 33%. DBS reports tomorrow morning and OCBC on Friday; DBS was down 1.8% and OCBC 2.2% by 12:05 SGT.

what_matters.tag_note: AMD · after Tuesday's New York close
what_matters.head: AMD's Q3 revenue of $13.4B beat its own forecast, and it expects about $17B in Q4.
what_matters.detail: The data-centre business nearly doubled from a year earlier to $8.5B. AMD says Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and Oracle are running work on its first Helios rack systems. CNBC reported the stock up 7% in late trading, later about 5% higher.

out.text: Q3 revenue $13.4B, up 45%, above the company's $12.7–13.3B forecast and the $13.1B analysts expected. Adjusted gross margin 56%, as forecast. Adjusted earnings per share $2.09 against $1.94 expected. Q4 forecast about $17B ± 3% at about 55% gross margin. Reported profit also carried a $1.1B charge from revaluing the warrants AMD issued to customers.

Q3 revenue about $14M against $13.4M analysts expected, against the company's $13.0–14.0M forecast. Adjusted loss of 3 cents a share against 4 cents expected. Q4 forecast $15.5–16.5M against $15.1M expected.

See What matters. Allowances for bad loans fell to S$258M from S$1.36B a year earlier, and bad loans fell to 1.5% of the book from 1.6%. The finance chief expects operating costs to rise by a mid- to high-single-digit percentage next year.

recent.headline: The AP projects that Democrats win both the House and the Senate, and US stock futures and Asian chip stocks fell on it.
Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal, and Lumentum fell 18.6%, about 3.4 times its usual daily move.
Intel fell 28.6% on Friday, about 7.5 times its usual daily move, and the chip fund fell 8.2%, about 3.5 times usual.
Alphabet fell 12.3% on Thursday, about 8 times its usual daily move, on volume 3.6 times normal. It was the first full session after its Q3 results.
Alphabet fell 9.8% in after-hours trading after its profit came in below forecasts. Microsoft rose 2.9% after hours on faster cloud growth. Neither move is in Wednesday's US prices.
